title: I sent robot forgeries to a handwriting expert
summary: Stuff Made Here builds a handwriting robot and sends its output to a handwriting expert to see whether it can pass as forgery. It walks through the engineering trials and errors along the way.
why: HN commenters recommend it as the physical-machine take on replicating handwriting, with plenty of explained iteration.

quote.text: really cool video by Stuff Made Here explaining how he tried to make 'realistic' handwritten forgeries with a pen plotter
